summary.headline: Fixed-Star Character Delineations
summary.text: Astrological delineations of fixed stars rising or culminating, including stars in Orion, Auriga, Sagittarius, the Gorgon, and the Twins, with their zodiacal degrees, latitudes, magnitudes, planetary temperaments, and effects on character, wealth, occupations, and military conduct.
